title: climate watch for greenhouse growers
description: Rasid reads the air in every span of the greenhouse and wakes the grower on duty before the crop feels it.

hero.headline: The vent stuck at three in the morning. Nobody was awake to see it.
hero.lead: Rasid keeps a live reading of heat, humidity and soil moisture in every span, holds it against the rule you agreed at planting, and rings the grower on duty the moment the two part company.
hero.note: No card needed. One house, one week, your own numbers.

logos.caption: Growing under Rasid this season
logos.note: Tomato, cucumber and cut-flower houses across the Jordan Valley and the northern highlands.

sections.title: A probe in every span, not one beside the door
sections.lead: Heat sits in layers and the door is the coldest place in the house. Rasid pairs a probe to each span and to the nursery bench, reads all of them on the same minute, and says which one is drifting away from the others.
ticks: Pairing is a QR code and a name; no gateway to configure.
A probe that stops answering is reported as missing, never averaged away.
Battery life is quoted per probe, with a warning three weeks out.

panel.title: Probes, Wadi Seer
panel.note: 40 probes answered on the minute, one answered late and is held for the morning round.

sections.title: The rule you agreed at planting is the one that wakes people
sections.lead: A night rule is a band, not a number: the temperature you will live with, the humidity above which mould starts, and the minutes you are willing to spend outside either before somebody is called.
ticks: One band per crop stage, copied to every house that grows it.
Ten minutes outside the band is a note; forty is a phone call.
A rule changed at midnight is stamped with the name that changed it.

panel.title: Night rule, tomato week 9
panel.note: Span C sat at 80% humidity for 26 minutes, which is a note in the log, not a call at 03:00.

sections.title: The person on duty gets one screen and two buttons
sections.lead: What is wrong, which house, how long it has been that way, and the two answers that change something: the vent opened by hand, or the call passed to the agronomist. Everything else waits for daylight.
ticks: The phone rings; it does not send a message into a group chat.
Works on the valley road where there is no signal, and catches up after.
Arabic and English, in the keyboard the grower already uses.

sections.title: The season keeps its own diary
sections.lead: A heater fails in February and the crop is three days late in May. Rasid keeps what the air was doing, who intervened and what they did, so the post-season meeting argues about the decision rather than the memory of it.

faq.title: What growers want settled before the probes go in
faq.note: Something else? Write to salam@rasid.farm and a person answers.

items.q: Does this replace the climate computer we already have?
items.a: No. Rasid reads the house and tells you when it drifts; the computer keeps doing the opening and closing. Nine of the farms on Rasid run a controller from the nineteen-nineties and have no plan to change it.

items.q: What happens when the internet in the valley goes down?
items.a: The probes keep reading and the base keeps storing. When the line comes back the night is filled in, and a gap longer than fifteen minutes is marked in the log so nobody reads it as a quiet night.

items.q: Can two farms share one account?
items.a: Yes. A house belongs to a farm, and a grower can be on duty for both. The log, the rules and the bill follow the house, not the person.

items.q: Who is woken when nobody answers?
items.a: The duty list is yours to write: a second name after five minutes, a third after ten, and a message to the farm owner if the third does not answer either.

items.q: How long before the first real night?
items.a: A house with power at the far end is watching the same evening. Agreeing the bands per crop stage is the slow part, so Rasid starts from the band your agronomist already uses on paper.

cta.title: Watch one house for a week.
cta.lead: Put probes in a single house and leave them a week. If the log tells you nothing you did not already know, take them out — there is nothing to cancel.
cta.note: Probes posted the same day. Your readings leave as a spreadsheet whenever you ask.
